name: Jellyfin Federation
description: Aggregate content from multiple Jellyfin servers into unified virtual libraries
overview: The Jellyfin Federation Plugin allows you to create a unified media library by aggregating content from multiple remote Jellyfin servers. Stream content from any server without file synchronization.
changelog: Premium laptop/TV polish and safer media management. Downloads now has remote-only movie/show browsing, season/episode folders, multi-select, source-owned bulk consent, and a separate live activity view with speed, ETA, status, and cancel. Storage cleanup shows covers and reclaim estimates, groups TV by show/season, and removes only exact local files after explicit confirmation and fresh revalidation; automatic better-copy replacement downloads are retired. Playback/download tokens are purpose-scoped and permissions are rechecked when bytes stream. Companion linking now uses revocable per-friend Plex relay credentials instead of exposing the Plex owner's real token, while stable item-bound relays make Jellyfin-to-Plex .strm playback survive token expiry.
